tooltip.changed_extra.fission_casing_upg: Replaces reactor casing. Cooling blocks and processors stack, adding about 1% each; server-configurable.
tooltip.changed_extra.advanced_fission_c: Each adds 1% water efficiency: water use / (1 + count * 1%), with unchanged steam and cooling.
tooltip.changed_extra.advanced_uranium_p: Each adds 1% fuel efficiency and 1% heat and waste output. Extra heat requires extra cooling.
Each adds 1 percentage point of refund chance (up to 100%). Refunds the tick's consumed fuel, retaining heat and waste.
tooltip.changed_extra.fission_emergency_: Stops the reactor before burning when water reserves are below 10 seconds of predicted demand. Restart after refilling.
tooltip.changed_extra.fission_me_interfa: Pulls water from ME storage to fill the reactor each tick, with no added transfer cap. Requires a channel and fixed AE power; no per-volume extraction charge.
jei.changed_extra.fission.install: Install as reactor casing. Only upgrades in the formed reactor count. Cooling blocks and processors stack.
jei.changed_extra.fission.cooling_info: Current server setting: +%s water efficiency per block. N blocks use 1/(1+N*bonus) water for unchanged steam output and cooling. Water use rounds up each tick.
jei.changed_extra.fission.x_info: Current server settings: +%s fuel efficiency and +%s heat/waste output per block. Fuel cost is divided by (1+count*fuel bonus); heat and waste multiply by (1+count*output bonus). Extra heat requires extra cooling.
jei.changed_extra.fission.y_info: Current server setting: +%s refund chance per block, stacking up to 100%%. A successful burning tick refunds its actual consumed fuel while retaining heat and waste. Works with processor X.
jei.changed_extra.fission.scram_info: Stops before burning when stored water / predicted water use per second is below 10 seconds. Prediction includes cooling and X upgrades; ME fills first. Restart after refilling. Does not interrupt sodium cooling.
jei.changed_extra.fission.me_info: A powered ME network with an active channel supplies water directly to the entire reactor tank each tick, with no added transfer rate cap. Fixed network draw: %s AE/t before AE2's power multiplier, configurable; no per-volume extraction charge. Only water is extracted; a full tank, disconnected network, or sodium coolant prevents extraction.
tooltip.changed_extra.fission_thermoelec: Auxiliary heat stabilization above 450 K. Higher temperature increases heat extraction; electricity is a byproduct. Permanently fuses at its thermal limit.
tooltip.changed_extra.thermo.inspect: Sneak + empty-hand right-click: status. Right-click with a heat exchange core: repair after shutdown below 450 K.
message.changed_extra.thermo.repair_unsa: Repair requires a formed, stopped reactor below 450 K.
message.changed_extra.thermo.repaired: Heat exchange core replaced. Module repaired.
message.changed_extra.thermo.rates: Heat: %s J/t | Generation: %s FE/t | Passive cooling: %s J/t
jei.changed_extra.fission.thermo_info: Auxiliary stabilization: starts at 450 K; nonlinear extraction reaches %s J/t per module at 1100 K. Responds to rising temperature. Efficiency = configured coefficient × (1 − ambient/reactor temperature). Heat is removed before steam production. Full buffers retain %s passive cooling. Shared output cap across all sides and APIs: %s FE/t per module.
jei.changed_extra.fission.thermo_fuse: Fuses at 1800 K, or at 1200 K with 100%% reactor damage; actual meltdown also fuses the module. Fusing stops generation and cooling, preserves stored power and does not break the casing. Multiple modules share available heat fairly. They cannot replace primary cooling. Broken state and energy persist through drops and reloads.
jei.changed_extra.fission.thermo_core: Right-click a fused thermoelectric module to consume one core and repair it. Requires a formed reactor, stopped and below 450 K. Does not consume stored energy.
tooltip.changed_extra.reverser: Uses WLP and DLP together to reverse gas materials through JSON recipes. Default: 1000 spent nuclear waste → 1000 fissile fuel in 1 s, 20 WLP/s + 20 DLP/s. Set its redstone behaviour with the redstone-mode tab.
tooltip.changed_extra.reverser.ports: Gas enters the back and exits the front by default; change it with a Mek Configurator or the side-config tab. WLP and DLP use their fixed side ports. Drain mode sends input back out of the input sides without deleting it. Radioactive contents follow Mek dismantling rules.
gui.changed_extra.reverser.drain_hint: Toggle input drain mode. Pauses work and pumps input back through the rear port; does not delete gas.
jei.changed_extra.gas.pipe: Uses the native Mek pressurized-tube network, capacities and Configurator controls. Convert Changed latex/transfur fluids using the Rotary Condensentrator, then synthesize gas in the Chemical Infuser. Keep different gases on separate networks.
